_comment: Local models every Codespace should have WITHOUT uploading: baked into the dev-container image by .github/workflows/devcontainer-image.yml and, if missing at runtime, fetched by the engine on start (see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md). URL forms: hf://org/repo/file.gguf or a direct https link. Round BE: five 3-4B-class instruct models (Q4_K_M, ~12 GB together) for the five slots, all voting at the same time - each is loaded with its share of the CPU threads (LocalModelAgent.thread_budget); a model whose measured vote does not fit the 9 s budget votes every fifth window instead of stalling the others. Needs a 4-core / 16 GB Codespace to run all five; on 8 GB machines disable two entries.

models.note: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507 Q4_K_M (~2.5 GB) - the non-thinking Qwen3 release; strongest small instruct model on structured JSON
Phi-4-mini Instruct 3.8B Q4_K_M (~2.5 GB) - Microsoft's small model, strong numeric reasoning
Gemma 3 4B IT Q4_K_M (~2.5 GB) - Google's 4B instruct model (needs llama-cpp-python >= 0.3.8)
Llama 3.2 3B Instruct Q4_K_M (~2.0 GB) - Meta's small instruct model, a different training lineage
Qwen2.5 3B Instruct Q4_K_M (~2.0 GB) - disciplined JSON, the fastest of the five
